{{Top}}
The '''R300-H hyperdrive motivator''' was a [[Hyperdrive motivator/Legends|hyperdrive motivator]] produced by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]] and used in the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] and some [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65B X-wing starfighters]]. It yielded a class one performance on standard [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]].
